evals.prompt: Execute this implementation plan: Plan.md is in the current directory and outlines a 5-step process to add authentication to our Express.js API using JWT tokens. Start with step 1.
evals.expected_output: Test-first execution of the plan in batches of at most 3 tasks, with preflight, a run ledger and an attended checkpoint after each batch
expectations: Output reads and confirms understanding of the plan before starting, and runs or describes preflight (clean tree, non-default branch, green baseline)
Output executes tasks sequentially or as a frontier of tasks with disjoint files, not all at once
Output writes a failing test and shows its red output before production code for each task
Output verifies each task with fresh Definition of Done output before reporting it DONE
Output stops at the attended checkpoint after a batch and reports what was done, rounds per loop and what comes next

evals.prompt: I have a 7-step database migration plan in /docs/migration-plan.md. Execute it but pause after each step to show me what changed before proceeding. If any step fails, stop and tell me what went wrong.
evals.expected_output: Careful step-by-step execution with explicit pauses, change summaries, and error handling
expectations: Output reads the migration plan from the specified location
Output executes exactly one step at a time
Output shows what changed after each step before asking to continue
Output stops and reports clearly if a step fails, recording the failed round (signature, cause, what was tried) and escalating at the loop bound instead of retrying without limit
Output tracks which steps are complete and which are remaining
